vulnerability.title: Rack::QueryParser parses an unbounded number of query parameters into a Hash, allowing memory and CPU exhaustion from a single request
vulnerability.category_l2: unbounded parameter parsing in Rack::QueryParser#parse_query (no total parameter-count or query-bytesize limit)

location.verification_method: Static read of query_parser.rb at the exact 2.2.3 commit and at tags v2.2.13 and v2.2.14, request.rb and utils.rb at the snapshot commit, the advisory-named fix patches (2bb5263, 3f5a424), and git object checks (blob identity, tag peel, merge-base ancestry). No Ruby code was compiled or executed and no query string was parsed.

critical_operation.code_excerpt:
def parse_query(qs, d = nil, &unescaper)
  unescaper ||= method(:unescape)

  params = make_params

  (qs || '').split(d ? (COMMON_SEP[d] || /[#{d}] */n) : DEFAULT_SEP).each do |p|
    next if p.empty?
    k, v = p.split('=', 2).map!(&unescaper)

    if cur = params[k]
      if cur.class == Array
        params[k] << v
      else
        params[k] = [cur, v]
      end
    else
      params[k] = v
    end
  end

  return params.to_h
end
critical_operation.description: parse_query 把整条 query string 按 &/; 切分，为每个键值对无条件写入一个 Hash（重复键退化为数组），循环次数只取决于输入长度，没有任何参数总数或字节数上限。唯一存在的约束是 key_space_limit：Params#[]= 只累加新键的字节数（169-172），值长度和参数个数完全不受限。因此单个请求可以携带几十万个参数，解析过程在内存里构建同规模的 Hash/Array 并消耗 CPU，直到 worker 被 OOM 或拖垮。修复 2bb5263 / 3f5a424 在 parse_query 与 parse_nested_query 入口调用 check_query_string，超过 BYTESIZE_LIMIT（4MB）或 PARAMS_LIMIT（4096）即抛 QueryLimitError。

entry_point.description: Rack 应用读取 params 时走 Rack::Request#GET：它把 env['QUERY_STRING'] 交给 parse_query(query_string, '&;')（430 行）。表单提交走 POST，对 application/x-www-form-urlencoded 请求体调用 parse_query(form_vars, '&')（454 行）。两条路径共用同一个无上限解析器；攻击者控制的就是 URL query string 或请求体，默认配置（make_default(65536, 100)，utils.rb:30）只限制键空间和嵌套深度，不限制参数个数。

trace.description: query_hash = parse_query(query_string, '&;') —— 未经任何长度/计数检查就进入解析器；结果随后缓存在 RACK_REQUEST_QUERY_HASH。
解析器入口：make_params 只创建一个受 key_space_limit 约束的 Params 容器，没有对 qs 的 bytesize 或分隔符数量做检查。
(qs || '').split(...).each —— split 会先按分隔符构造出与参数个数同规模的数组，再逐个插入 Hash；输入参数越多，瞬时内存和循环次数线性增长，没有中途退出条件。
@size += key.size if key && !@params.key?(key) —— 只累计新键的字节数，且只与 key_space_limit 比较；值的字节数和新参数个数的增加对 @size 没有影响，因此大量短键或长值都能绕过。
params.to_h 把完整结果转换成 Hash 返回，规模由攻击者输入决定，随后被 Request#GET 缓存。

source_crosscheck.notes: CNA、NVD 与 OSV 在三个修复版本、CVSS 向量与 CWE 上完全一致；技术描述同源于 GitHub advisory。唯一的独立材料是上游 git 本身：2.2.3 的 parser 无任何计数限制，v2.2.14 的 parser 引入 4MB/4096 限制，且 3f5a424 是 v2.2.14 tag 提交的祖先。分级冲突仅存在于 SSVC（CISA ADP: Automatable yes / Technical Impact partial），与 CVSS 等级无关。

required_before_promotion: An independent reviewer must read lib/rack/query_parser.rb at 2.2.3 (commit 1741c580) and confirm the parse_query loop writes every parameter into Params with no count/bytesize bound, and that Params#[]= constrains key bytes only.
An independent reviewer must confirm that lib/rack/request.rb GET (430) and POST (454) both reach this parser from attacker-controlled input.
An independent reviewer must confirm the v2.2.14 file (blob d9b1e876) contains check_query_string with the 4194304/4096 defaults and that 3f5a424 is an ancestor of the v2.2.14 tag commit.
No formal reviews row may be written until a named independent reviewer returns a verdict.

limitations: Single-reviewer dossier; not eligible for data/vulnerabilities.jsonl yet.
No Ruby code was executed and no query string was parsed: the resource-exhaustion impact is read from the code path and the advisory, not measured.
Only the 2.2 line was mapped. 3.0.x and 3.1.x carry the same unchecked parser and are fixed by 3.0.16 / 3.1.14, but those files were not read here.

The 2.2 fix commit 3f5a424 is a backport; the main-branch commit 2bb5263 is NOT an ancestor of the v2.2.14 tag. Fixed-release content was verified by git blob identity plus ancestry of 3f5a424, not by ancestry of 2bb5263.

Whether an individual application limits query length upstream (reverse proxy, server, middleware) decides the practical impact; the advisory itself lists those as mitigations and this dossier makes no claim about any specific deployment.
CWE-400 and CWE-770 both come from the CNA; NVD publishes the same pair from the GitHub source rather than an independent root-cause analysis.
open_questions: Whether the multipart path in Rack::Request#POST has a separate parameter-count limit in 2.2.3 (it is not the query parser and was not mapped here).
Whether Rack::QueryParser.max_keys or any Rack::Utils configuration in applications can bound the count in practice.
Whether a public non-vendor analysis of this CVE exists; none is saved in sources.
